items.title: Norman Mason Interview, 1960-02-06
items.q: They came with Oliver... He went with Oliver for a while... And he didn't stay with Oliver's band

ctx.x: I remember a time he went with Fletcher Hanson... Uh... He went with Fletcher... He didn't stay there... Those... They came with Oliver... He went with Oliver for a while... And he didn't stay with Oliver's band... Because I found out that mostly... Uh... Particularly at that... At that time... Uh... The people wasn't, uh... They were not interested in... In letting a talent... Let you develop your talent... They want you to play what they wanted to play... And, of course, when they... That was not quite…
Did you, uh... Were you in Mobile?
